text: I follow your will.
Although you knew about his pedantic habit from before, you still haven't gotten used to it.
Let's just chat normally.
Naturally, I shall speak of all things.
(Forget it, getting him to change probably won't happen quickly anyway.)
According to the documents, you don't seem to remember your cause of death?
That is correct.
Well then, I'll ask some questions next. If you remember anything, let me know.
This leaf you're carrying is a potent poison. Did you know that?
Poison? How can that be? The Priest said this is a trial given to us by the Holy Mother.
The kitten's eyes widen, verbally denying it.
Trial?
After consuming it, our souls leave our bodies and approach the Supreme Being.
The Priest said, brothers and sisters who cannot withstand the test will return to the Holy Mother's side, and only those who succeed can continue their practice.
(Calling the hallucinations and confusion caused by toxicity the power of a deity, and talking about 'failing the test'... It's clearly poisoning!)
I must remind you—
Everything is false, isn't it?
I don't believe you! You haven't been to Heaven! How do I know you're not lying to me?
You are speechless. You have no reason to lie to him, but he is just unwilling to let his faith collapse and doesn't really expect an answer from you.
When I go to Heaven, I will see it with my own eyes!
Next...
Can you tell me about your life? Have you always lived in a place like a monastery?
Foolish! The Priest bears the duty of the 'Witness' and travels the land. We naturally accompany him, offering our assistance.
Seemingly annoyed by a stupid question, Joshua mutters discontentedly, too low to make out clearly.
So you've never settled in one place?
He is unwilling to answer, just beating around the bush.

Our Holy Mother has been slumbering for many years. Many beings have long forgotten the Holy Mother's revered name and are unwilling to listen to the holy words. The world is like this, chilling our hearts.

(As a cult, they must face expulsion and arrest. This so-called 'traveling' is probably just the Priest's rhetoric.
)
You're amazing, life must have been hard, right?
Really? I don't think it was particularly hard.
You are speechless. Having lived in hardship since childhood, he has long taken it for granted.
Next...
Can you tell me what you went through to gain the qualification to become an 'angel'?
You already said it's fake, why should I say anything?
Because you repeatedly denied his faith, he seems a bit angry and no longer uses those pedantic phrases.
But you must have something special to become an angel, right? A natural gift? Or does it require ascetic practice?
Sure enough, after being coaxed a bit, Joshua takes the bait and starts talking incessantly.
It's much more than that!
First, you must remain pure! Otherwise, connecting with Mother on a soul level is simply impossible.
My age is the best for this.
This is not surprising; most religions emphasize this.
But there must be more to it, right?
Correct! Next, you must undergo screening.
Screening?
Joshua originally wanted to say more, but he pauses and ultimately just lets out a profound hum, saying nothing further.

(Perhaps this involves some 'secrets' of their religion......
)
You still want to ask...
Is that necklace of yours the symbol of the Holy Mother?
No mistake.
As a witness, one must wear the symbol of the Holy Mother while traveling.
Mother is merciful, protecting her children, granting them strength.
Was this also taught by the Priest?
Of course. The Priest is the spokesperson of the Holy Mother on earth, every word teaching us the greatness of the Holy Mother.
You still want to ask...
You show Joshua a photo of Bob.
Have you ever seen this cat before?
His information is incomplete, and he can't remember anything himself. Helpless, you become the cat holding a photo and broadcasting a 'missing cat notice' everywhere.
Joshua is so young, to be honest, you didn't have much hope.
......He seems to have lived with us for a while before.
Really?
The timeline here is chaotic; the order of cats' time of death and their souls' arrival here has no reference value to each other.
So, although Joshua is so young, it's entirely possible that Bob arrived here first.
I can't say clearly, we were all still very young at that time.
We kittens were all orphans, saved by the Priest. After that, many cats couldn't withstand the practice and ran away.
It might also just be a coincidence that they look similar.
The kitten pouts, shaking his head saying he doesn't remember anything else besides this.
You still want to ask...
I imagine there aren't many who can become a Witness like you, right? You must have witnessed all the myriad forms of life in the world.
That is natural.
All of this is for the Holy Mother. The Holy Mother has awakened from her slumber and urgently needs us to offer our purest faith.
Deities draw power from earthly beings; although this is already a common form, you ultimately couldn't bear to deny him again, seeing the reverence shining in Joshua's eyes.
So you came here? To devote yourself to the Holy Mother?
Oh! Precisely!
Exactly so! I remember now, I completed the ritual under the Priest's guidance!
Ritual?
(It couldn't be a sacrifice...?)
This involves many steps; I cannot explain it clearly to you...
Like those ascetics? Fasting, vegetarianism, all-night meditation?
Joshua falls silent, saying no more. But you have formed your own suspicions and decide not to press further.
Sorry, I'm just really curious.
...You have not received the Holy Mother's baptism; it is not appropriate for me to tell you more.
It sounds like the Priest not only takes care of your daily lives but also travels extensively?
Exactly so. The Priest sheltered us in our youth and enlightened us.
Only after we formally received the Holy Mother's radiant baptism did we embark on our journey of travel.
You already know he is in a cult, and now you also feel doubt about that Priest's "care" and "protection".
What about your parents?
The Holy Mother is our supreme mother; the Priest, as her spokesperson on earth, is our father on earth.
(He is an orphan.)
That Priest was really good to you, wasn't he?
Of course.
If it weren't for him, we would have long since died from hunger and cold.
A glimmer of moisture flashes in his eyes.
Ah, how I wish I could see him again. May the Holy Mother bless him.
Is there anything else you wish to ask?
No, that's all.
The young kitten takes his leave with perfect politeness, the doorbell chiming softly as he departs.
